label: Sukabumi
short_description: West Java's Sukabumi regency, gateway to Situ Gunung and Pelabuhan Ratu, southwest of Bogor.
intro: Sukabumi's hotels in this directory sit in the regency south of Bogor and southwest of Jakarta, a distinct West Java destination built around nature tourism rather than the Bogor/Puncak weekend-retreat crowd -- Situ Gunung's suspension bridge and crater lake, white-water rafting on the Citatih and Cicatih rivers, and the south-coast surf beaches around Pelabuhan Ratu. Properties here tend to be resort-style, set among rice terraces and forest rather than in a dense town center. Sukabumi is reached via the Bogor-Ciawi-Sukabumi toll road, roughly an hour south of Bogor and around two hours from Jakarta by car.
